definitions.orisCode: EIA plant ID, which is the same number EPA uses as the facility's ORIS code.
definitions.covered: True when at least one EPA CAMPD unit was matched to the plant's peaker generators; false means EPA has no emissions reporting for it.
definitions.match: How the EPA units were tied to the plant's EIA generators.
definitions.units: EIA generator IDs at the plant that pass the peakers.json filter (prime mover GT or IC, grid-serving sector).
definitions.epaUnits: The EPA reporting units counted for the plant, with the EIA generators EPA ties to each and per-unit hours by year.
definitions.quartersReported: Calendar quarters for which EPA has emissions records for any of the plant's units in that year.
definitions.unitsReporting: Number of the plant's EPA units with at least one emissions record that year (a unit can report zero operation).
definitions.unitsThatRan: Number of those units with more than zero operating hours that year.
definitions.operatingHoursAllUnits: EPA operating time (sumOpTime) summed across units; double-counts hours when several units ran at once.
definitions.operatingHoursMaxUnit: Operating hours of the single unit that ran the most that year; the cleaner answer to how many hours the plant ran.
definitions.hoursWithAnyOperationMaxUnit: For the busiest unit, the count of clock hours in which it operated at all, even briefly (EPA countOpTime).
definitions.grossLoadMWh: Gross electrical output in megawatt-hours, summed across units (before the plant's own use).
definitions.heatInputMMBtu: Fuel heat input in million British thermal units, summed across units.
definitions.co2Tons: Carbon dioxide emitted, short tons, summed across units.
definitions.noxTons: Nitrogen oxides emitted, short tons, summed across units.
definitions.daysAnyUnitOperated: Number of calendar days in 2025 on which at least one of the plant's units had operating time (from EPA daily data).
definitions.ytdThrough: Latest calendar quarter of the current year that EPA has published for these plants.
definitions.retirement: Generator status from the newest EIA 860M workbook: planned retirement dates, generators on its Retired sheet, and generators marked out of service.
definitions.peakerRule: Short notes on the New York DEC Peaker Rule (6 NYCRR Subpart 227-3) and NYISO reliability designations, each with a primary-source URL and quote; omitted where no primary source was found.
definitions.totals: Sums across all covered plants per year (null values skipped).
definitions.totalsExcludingCombinedCycle: The same sums leaving out plants whose EPA units are combined-cycle (East River), i.e. the simple-cycle peakers only.
